fact: The governor of Haut-Uélé province handed Starlink satellite internet kits to the heads of the decentralised territorial entities (ETD) at Isiro on 17 March 2026, in a province where the lack of a telecom network remains a problem, on a provincial information note read by ACP; the kits are reported handed over, not installed, and who pays the subscription is not stated.

The Starlink kits handed over in Haut-Uélé on 17 March 2026 are for the heads of the entities to send security alerts to the provincial capital in real time, on the governor's word; no system worked in over the link is named.

45 chiefdoms and sectors of Haut-Uélé province received Starlink kits on 17 March 2026, beside 6 territories and security services, on the provincial information note; one province only, with no total of entities given.

On 17 March 2026 the governor of Haut-Uélé handed Starlink satellite internet kits to 45 chiefdoms and sectors and 6 territories, following the recommendations of the 2025 forum on security governance.
The Starlink kits were handed to the entities by the governor of Haut-Uélé province on 17 March 2026, the provincial government being the only provider the report names.
The report of 18 March 2026 on the Starlink kits handed over in Haut-Uélé names no budget or funder for the kits or their subscriptions.
